$comment: The CopilotKit and AG-UI releases the adapter suite (pnpm --filter @alixai/copilotkit-adapter test) is run against. 'packages' is flat and exact so that tests/copilotkit (M3-28) can pin its devDependencies from it. 'primary' is the entry installed in the workspace; node compat/run.mjs installs every other entry in a scratch directory and runs the same suite. test/matrix.test.ts fails when the primary entry and the installed versions differ.

notes: useCopilotChat() of @copilotkit/react-core returns visibleMessages as undefined in this release (its wrapper reads a member the internal hook no longer returns): read the messages from useCopilotChatInternal().messages or the agent, as test/ui.v1.test.tsx does.

useInterrupt, useRenderTool, useConfigureSuggestions, useAgent and renderActivityMessages are from @copilotkit/react-core/v2; the structured blocks, the confirmation card and the suggestion pills need the v2 CopilotChat, CopilotSidebar or CopilotPopup. The v1 components of @copilotkit/react-ui show the streamed text and the headless hook works, but they render no activity messages.
useInterrupt refuses to resume an interrupt whose expiresAt has passed (the goldens' fixed expiry is moved forward by the fake gateway for the UI tests).
Published after the workspace's release-age policy allows, so the scratch install of compat/run.mjs sets minimumReleaseAge to 0 for it; the workspace itself stays on 1.76.0.

notCovered: @copilotkit/* before 1.76.0 depend on @ag-ui/client 0.0.59, which predates the interrupt outcome and resume of the AG-UI release AlixAI implements (@ag-ui/core 1.0.1); they are not tested and not claimed.

readBy.COPILOTKIT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED: @copilotkit/runtime dist/v2/runtime/telemetry/telemetry-client.mjs and dist/lib/telemetry-disclosure.mjs (read once, when the module loads)
readBy.DO_NOT_TRACK: the same two files, and @scarf/scarf report.js
